scope: All Float32 physical O vertices, all Float32 face centroids and all unique-edge midpoints queried against 185 typed banks; body transforms rebound to native current all_bodies; query margin 5um with AABB branch-and-bound; not an exact surface or solid admission gate.
sample_cast_policy: Use exact Float32 physical O positions; compute face centers/edge midpoints in Float64 from Float32 endpoints then cast every sample to Float32 before frame transforms and queries.
bank_pose_rebind: Each body transform/position uses native all_bodies Float32 current quaternion/position; pinned local triangles and COM offsets remain unchanged.
limitations: Minima are over vertices, face centroids, and unique-edge midpoints, not all points on triangles; this can miss between-sample closest approaches.
Signs use the pinned Fast Winding Number policy; ambiguous samples are reported separately. The exact all-surface crossing audit is separate.
This report does not establish a solid containment certificate, layer thickness, positive cell Jacobians, mass conservation, native dynamics, or admission.
